message: Build a multi-page React developer portfolio site for a fictional developer: Home, About, Projects, project detail pages and Contact, with working internal navigation between the pages. Animated typography on headings, a projects gallery with interactive project cards and hover effects, elegant dark style, responsive navigation on mobile, accessible links.
